scenarios.description: Folder of scenario files (.md, .csv), relative to this file. Default: scenarios

recordings.description: Folder that receives one sub-folder per run, relative to this file. Default: .local/recordings

defaults.description: Settings for every conversation that leaves them out (same keys as a scenario's front matter).

baseline.description: Run folder (relative to recordings) that later runs are compared with.

gifMaxBytes.description: A GIF above this size is flagged. Default: 15000000

videoSlackSeconds.description: How much longer than its cut list an MP4 may be before it is flagged. Default: 3

minBytesPerMegapixel.description: A reply screenshot that compresses below this is flagged as blank. Default: 7000 (a blank Chromium screenshot is about 5600, a sparse chat about 18000)

canary.description: Messages the doctor sends. Default: ["Hi", "What can you help me with?"]

packsUrl.description: Where `afrec selectors update` downloads selector packs (a folder holding index.json).
